title: Privilege Atlas: Workspace Role Evolution + Cost-Context Rollout Prototype
creator: Ava Patel
description: Problem: Admins struggle to understand how role changes ripple across workspaces, what permissions different roles actually grant, and how role rollouts affect cost attribution and active workload routing. Goal: Create a compact, scannable console surface that maps role lifecycles (creation → modification → deprecation), visualizes which workspaces and services are affected, and surfaces cost and rollout guidance for safe staged deployments. The prototype should integrate with Audit Log timelines, show immediate/estimated cost delta for role-driven route changes (e.g., routing to Dedicated vs Hosted), and provide a simple canary rollout composer tied to permissions scopes.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity prototype (desktop) demonstrating: role lifecycle map, affected-workspace list, permission diff view, and cost-impact strip for role changes
Canary rollout composer UI that ties a role change to: (a) a percentage of traffic, (b) workspace filters, and (c) automated rollback conditions
Audit timeline integration: selecting a role event highlights related audit entries and shows user-level access-change details
Design spec with component variants, accessibility notes (contrast, keyboard nav), and implementation tokens for console-2025.12
Usability test script and results summary with at least 6 product/platform participants and 80% task completion for key flows
comments: 2025-11-08 - Ava Patel: Initial sketch uploaded to Figma; included three approaches for mapping — radial, layered timeline, and treemap. Preference for timeline+graph hybrid to keep event chronology clear.

2025-11-09 - Marcus Li: Engineering note — must surface permission-impact hooks at the API level (role_id + permission_delta) so rollouts can call the runtime router. ENG-4021 is tracking the backend contract.

2025-11-10 - Priya Rao: PM feedback — emphasize cost-context on the role edit flow (show estimated per-day token-cost change) and make opt-in toggles for autoscaling Dedicated pools when promoting a role to high-throughput workspaces.
2025-11-11 - Seth Nguyen: Accessibility review — need larger hit targets for the canary slider and ensure timeline is keyboard-draggable. Added notes in Figma.

2025-11-12 - Elena García: Design critique — prefer inline permission diffs instead of modal; proposed a compact 'diff bar' that expands inline. Also suggested adding a 'preview-as' impersonation quicklink for audit context.

2025-11-13 - Marcus Li: Implementability check passed for main flows; flagged two edge cases in comments (cross-workspace inherited roles, ephemeral grants) that need PM decision. See ENG-4267 for follow-up.
decisions: Choose timeline+graph hybrid for Role Lifecycle view (decision date: 2025-11-09)
Inline permission diff bar chosen over modal to keep context; expandable rows for long permission lists (decision date: 2025-11-12)
Expose estimated cost delta as a daily and 30-day projection next to role changes; mark as approximate and link to cost breakdown dashboard (decision date: 2025-11-10)
Canary rollout composer will default to 5% of traffic with 30-minute evaluation window and safety rollback threshold of 5% error increase (decision date: 2025-11-11)
usability_findings: Participants preferred inline diffs and could complete 'identify affected workspaces' task in median 48s
Confusion around 'route cost delta' label — renamed to 'Estimated per-day cost impact' per test feedback
Users wanted clearer separation between role semantics (permissions) and traffic routing (deployment) — added contextual headers and microcopy
Canary composer slider needed discrete stops (1%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 50%) to support common rollout patterns
next_steps: PM to resolve inherited role edge cases with platform (PM-222) and update acceptance criteria
Hand off detailed component spec to engineering with token table and QA checklist (target: 2025-11-20)
Create ENG spike ticket for audit log correlation index to support fast event lookups (suggested: ENG-4267)
Schedule a design walkthrough with security for the security_review_required signoff (owner: Ava Patel, target: 2025-11-18)
